title: A Voyager 2 map of Jupiter, 28 June 1979

statements.text: Björn Jónsson, from NASA/JPL Voyager images archived at the PDS Ring-Moon Systems Node
statements.scope: The map: 135 Voyager 2 narrow-angle frames (45 orange, 45 green, 45 violet) taken on 1979-06-28 between 12:04:47 and 20:42:23 UTC, reprojected, illumination-adjusted and mosaicked by the author.

statements.text: Publicly available; no permission needed; credit "created by Björn Jónsson". The author asks sites to link to his maps, not to host a copy.

Red and blue are corrected from the orange and violet frames. Smooth dummy data fills gaps near the poles, mostly the south; the author's mask marks it, with real data he judged useless and small manual seam repairs.
statements.scope: Color and polar coverage of the map.
